extraFacts.fact: ASME B1.20.1 covers general-purpose inch pipe threads: NPT is a taper thread with a 60° thread form that seals on the threads, and NPSM is a straight (parallel) thread for free-fitting mechanical joints that does not seal on the thread.

316L is the low-carbon grade of 316 austenitic stainless steel (carbon 0.03 % maximum), which is why it can be welded without carbide precipitation at the grain boundaries; it contains molybdenum for resistance to chloride pitting.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A240 / A276 chemical composition limits for UNS S31603

faqs.q: What is the NPSM swivel female 60° cone used for?
faqs.a: The NPSM swivel female 60° cone is a 316L stainless-steel female NPSM swivel hose fitting with a straight (parallel) pipe thread from 1/8" to 2" and a 60° cone seat, in the straight form. It connects a stainless hose to a male NPSM end with a 60° cone nose, and the swivel nut lets it be tightened without twisting the hose; it is the standard straight stainless NPSM hose end.

faqs.q: How do I read the part number IH-SS-T43-FPX-04-04 on the NPSM swivel female 60° cone?
faqs.a: IH-SS-T43-FPX-04-04 is for a 1/4" hose (dash -04) and a 1/4" NPSM female swivel (1/4-18). In the NPSM swivel female 60° cone part numbers the first two-digit number is the hose dash size and the second is the port size, so IH-SS-T43-FPX-16-16 is for a 1" hose and a 1" NPSM female swivel (1-11.5).

faqs.q: Which sizes does the NPSM swivel female 60° cone come in?
faqs.a: The NPSM swivel female 60° cone size table runs from hose size -04 (1/4") to -32 (2"). Ports run from 1/4" NPSM female swivel to 2" NPSM female swivel, and every part number gives both sizes.

faqs.q: How do I size the NPSM swivel female 60° cone?
faqs.a: Pick the hose dash first, then the NPSM port: the part number gives both, so IH-SS-T43-FPX-04-04 is a 1/4" hose to a 1/4" NPSM port. The table runs from 1/4" to 2" and mixing NPT with NPSM is the commonest ordering mistake.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the NPSM swivel female 60° cone have?
faqs.a: The listing gives the NPSM swivel female 60° cone no pressure figure of its own: the pressure of the finished assembly tracks the hose grade and ferrule when it is crimped to the correct diameter. Pick the hose first, then confirm that the hose rating suits the NPSM straight pipe 1/8" to 2" port before you order.

faqs.q: What is the NPSM swivel female 60° cone made from, and where does stainless suit it?
faqs.a: The NPSM swivel female 60° cone is machined from 316L stainless steel, passivated with no plating, so its corrosion resistance comes from the native oxide layer. It suits marine, chemical, food-grade and washdown service where zinc-plated carbon steel corrodes. The listing gives -40°C to +200°C, limited by the hose and any O-ring.

faqs.q: Which standards does the NPSM swivel female 60° cone follow?
faqs.a: The NPSM swivel female 60° cone is listed to ASME B1.20.1 for NPT and NPSM. NPSM is a straight thread that does not seal on its flanks, so on this fitting the 60° cone seat makes the seal and the thread only holds the nut.

faqs.q: What does the NPSM swivel female 60° cone connect to?
faqs.a: The female swivel nut of the NPSM swivel female 60° cone screws onto a male NPSM end with a 60° cone nose. It will not make a thread seal on a tapered NPT male, and the hose side takes an SS316L crimp ferrule; see our [stainless crimp hose fittings](/c/stainless-crimp-hose-fittings).

faqs.q: How should the NPSM swivel female 60° cone be fitted to avoid leaks?
faqs.a: Run the nut of the NPSM swivel female 60° cone on by hand, then tighten with a spanner while holding the straight body, so the cone seats and the hose is not twisted. Do not use thread tape to seal a cone joint, and lubricate the stainless thread lightly to prevent galling.

faqs.q: NPSM swivel female 60° cone or the 90° elbow?
faqs.a: The straight NPSM swivel female 60° cone keeps the hose in line, while the [90° elbow](/p/npsm-swivel-female-60-cone-90-elbow) turns it through a right angle and the [45° elbow](/p/npsm-swivel-female-60-cone-45-elbow) through 45°. Thread and cone are identical.

faqs.q: What is the NPT male pipe straight used for?
faqs.a: The NPT male pipe straight is a 316L stainless-steel straight hose fitting with a male NPT taper thread from 1/8" to 2" that seals on the thread as it is tightened. It screws into a female NPT port on a pump, valve or tank, and is used on stainless hose assemblies where the thread joint is the seal.

faqs.q: How do I read the part number IH-SS-T43-MP-04-02 on the NPT male pipe straight?
faqs.a: IH-SS-T43-MP-04-02 is for a 1/4" hose (dash -04) and a 1/8" NPT male (1/8-27). In the NPT male pipe straight part numbers the first two-digit number is the hose dash size and the second is the port size, so IH-SS-T43-MP-10-08 is for a 5/8" hose and a 1/2" NPT male (1/2-14).

faqs.q: Which sizes does the NPT male pipe straight come in?
faqs.a: The NPT male pipe straight size table runs from hose size -04 (1/4") to -32 (2"). Ports run from 1/8" NPT male to 2" NPT male, and every part number gives both sizes.

faqs.q: How do I choose the hose and NPT port sizes for the NPT male pipe straight?
faqs.a: Pick the hose dash first, then the NPT thread of the port: the first number in the part number is the hose dash and the second is the port dash, so IH-SS-T43-MP-04-02 is a 1/4" hose to a 1/8" NPT male. Mixed sizes are common, such as -12 hose to a -16 port.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the NPT male pipe straight have?
faqs.a: The listing gives the NPT male pipe straight no pressure figure of its own: the pressure of the finished assembly tracks the hose grade and ferrule when it is crimped to the correct diameter. Pick the hose first, then confirm that the hose rating suits the NPT taper 1/8" to 2" port before you order.

faqs.q: What is the NPT male pipe straight made from, and where does stainless suit it?
faqs.a: The NPT male pipe straight is machined from 316L stainless steel, passivated with no plating, so its corrosion resistance comes from the native oxide layer. It suits marine, chemical, food-grade and washdown service where zinc-plated carbon steel corrodes. The listing gives -40°C to +200°C, limited by the hose and any O-ring.

faqs.q: Which standards does the NPT male pipe straight follow?
faqs.a: The NPT male pipe straight is listed to ASME B1.20.1 for NPT. NPT is a 60° taper thread that seals on the thread, with sealant, so it is torqued by turns rather than to a seat.

faqs.q: What does the NPT male pipe straight connect to?
faqs.a: It screws into a female NPT port or coupling. It does not mate with a parallel NPSM or BSPP female, and the hose side takes an SS316L crimp ferrule; see our [stainless crimp hose fittings](/c/stainless-crimp-hose-fittings).

faqs.q: How should a stainless NPT male thread be sealed and tightened?
faqs.a: Apply PTFE tape or an anti-seize sealant suitable for stainless steel to the male thread and tighten by turns, not by torque. Stainless taper threads gall easily, so avoid over-tightening and never reuse a fitting that has seized once.

faqs.q: NPT male pipe straight or NPSM swivel female 60° cone: how do I choose?
faqs.a: The NPT male pipe straight has a taper thread that seals on the thread, while the [NPSM swivel female 60° cone](/p/npsm-swivel-female-60-cone) has a straight thread and seals on a 60° cone. They fit different ports, so identify the port thread first.
